item.name: Boundless Rage
item.effect: Plays a transformation-style animation, then leaves a cosmetic aura on the player.
item.cardSummary: A limited aura emote that powers up with a short cutscene and then wraps the avatar in a lasting visual aura. Sold only through the rotating LIMITED shop, not random emote spins.

item.name: Inner Rage
item.effect: Grants a large cosmetic aura with no long cutscene lock.
item.secondaryEffect: Aura color can be customized when equipping or using the emote.
item.cardSummary: A budget limited aura that skips a heavy cutscene and focuses on a big, customizable-color power-up glow around your character.

item.name: Final Stand
item.effect: Plays a transformation animation, then leaves a cosmetic aura on the player.
item.cardSummary: A mid-price limited aura emote with a Beast-style power-up presentation and a lasting visual aura after the animation ends.

item.name: Lifeform
item.effect: Stone Mask transformation sequence that ends with a bright Ultimate Thing-style aura.
item.cardSummary: A limited aura emote built around a mask-and-claws transformation, finishing with shining red eyes and a colorful aura effect.

item.name: Shadow Eruption
item.effect: Grants a cosmetic shadow-themed aura after the emote finishes.
item.cardSummary: A limited shadow-themed aura emote from the Robux LIMITED shop for players who want a darker visual glow.

item.name: True Aura
item.effect: Plays a charged transformation animation, then leaves a cosmetic aura on the player.
item.cardSummary: A limited aura emote with a dramatic charge-up sequence that leaves a strong visual aura after the animation.

item.name: Eternal Seal
item.effect: Special kill sequence on a downed opponent; chat shows that the victim has been sealed.
item.cardSummary: The cheapest limited kill emote. It seals a defeated player in a Prison Realm-style finisher and posts a sealed message in chat.

item.name: Last Will
item.effect: Counters a jumping victim, kicks them skyward, then finishes with a beam that launches them away.
item.cardSummary: A limited kill emote where the downed opponent lunges first, then you kick them up and fire a finishing beam.

item.name: Speedster
item.effect: Runs speed rings around the victim, spawns clone afterimages, then hits with a synchronized delayed blast.
item.cardSummary: A limited high-speed kill emote that circles the downed opponent with afterimages before a simultaneous strike sends them flying.

item.name: Lightning Blitz
item.effect: Iaido draw-and-sheath dash through the victim with yellow lightning and a delayed shockwave finish.
item.cardSummary: A limited kill emote that vanishes in a lightning dash through the opponent, then sheathes to trigger a delayed finishing blast.

item.name: Wombo Combo
item.effect: High-energy clap-and-swap style kill sequence ending in a proud finishing pose.
item.cardSummary: A limited kill emote built around flashy Todo-style motions, hand claps, and a triumphant finisher on a downed player.

item.name: Omega Barrage
item.effect: Relentless high-speed punch barrage on the victim ending in a cinematic final impact.
item.cardSummary: A limited kill emote that pins the defeated player under a blazing multi-hit barrage before a big finishing blow.

item.name: Pocket Dimension
item.effect: Opens a void or dimensional tear that pulls the victim fully off the arena floor.
item.cardSummary: A limited kill emote that drops a defeated player into a pocket-dimension portal and seals the void shut behind them.

item.name: Final Spark
item.effect: Black-spark charge and energy flash kill sequence that freezes then engulfs the opponent in light.
item.cardSummary: A limited cinematic kill emote with dark crackling sparks, a blinding energy flash, and a triumphant pose after the finisher.

item.name: The Strongest
item.effect: Applies a cursed-energy M1 visual and an infinity-style melee presentation after use.
item.cardSummary: A limited melee-effect emote that dresses your punches with Gojo-style cursed energy and infinity visuals. Cosmetic only.

item.name: Beast Form
item.effect: Scream transformation into a crimson-and-purple Beast-style aura with a calm martial stance.
item.secondaryEffect: Pairs aura presentation with melee-effect styling while active.
item.cardSummary: A limited hybrid emote that transforms into a fierce red-and-purple Beast aura and settles into a combat-ready stance.

item.name: Divine Form
item.effect: Grants a cosmetic aura after the transformation animation.
item.secondaryEffect: Successful blocks play a special dodge animation while the aura effect is active.
item.cardSummary: A limited hybrid that combines a post-emote aura with a special block dodge animation on successful defenses.

item.name: The Fallen
item.effect: First use applies a melee effect that enables a custom kill animation while active.
item.secondaryEffect: Second use plays a large cosmetic slash that scatters a dead player's limbs.
item.cardSummary: A dual-use limited emote: first press gives Sukuna-style melee and kill effects, second press fires a world-cutting cosmetic slash.

item.name: My Brother
item.effect: Summons a random Roblox friend as a large cosmetic companion that mirrors M1s and has a custom kill animation.
item.secondaryEffect: Companion is purely cosmetic and can be disabled in settings.
item.cardSummary: A premium limited companion emote that spawns a friend-list buddy to pose, punch, and finish kills with you—visual only, no real damage.

item.name: Emerge
item.effect: Kill emote that turns the defeated player into a sword-wielding cosmetic companion following you.
item.secondaryEffect: Companion mirrors M1s and custom kills; can be disabled in settings like My Brother.
item.cardSummary: The most expensive limited emote. Finishing a kill summons the victim as a shadow-soldier-style companion with a blue sword for cosmetic attacks.
